metas.name: Motorway Cops: Catching Britain's Speeders
metas.description: Ride along with the officers risking their lives policing Britain's most dangerous roads.

metas.name: Geordie Coppers
metas.description: Following Newcastle’s neighbourhood police teams and their partners as they tackle crime, disorder and the many unexpected challenges of keeping one of Britain’s liveliest cities safe.

metas.name: Traffic Cops: Pursuit Squad One
metas.description: Follow the UK's highly trained police bikers as they race to save lives and catch suspects.

metas.name: Police Interceptors
metas.description: Documentary series profiling the work of high-speed police units across Britain.

metas.name: Street Cops: Catching the Yobs
metas.description: Following Britain's police as they head out to clean up the streets, from chasing down illegal e-scooters, and tackling drunks rampaging through the town centre, to cutting brazen drug dealers down to size.

metas.name: Reported Missing
metas.description: Every two minutes someone in Britain goes missing. Multiple cameras follow the hunt for missing people, from the police tasked with finding them to loved ones left at home.

metas.name: Traffic Cops
metas.description: An action-packed documentary series following Yorkshire-based law enforcers. Originally shown by the BBC (2003-2016), this is the new reboot format of the show and was titled "All New Traffic Cops" for two series. It was renamed again in 2018 as "Traffic Cops: On the Edge" and then as "Traffic Cops".

metas.name: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
metas.description: Unfiltered and up close. The realities and challenges of 24/7 policing in Belfast. Stephen Nolan gets a powerful insight into law and order on the front line.

metas.name: Forensics: Crash Scene Investigators
metas.description: Forensic collision investigators assess crash scenes using technology and detective work.

metas.name: Police Interceptors: Taking Down the Shoplifting Gangs
metas.description: Officers tackle the thieves terrorising supermarkets and shops, with organised international crime groups stealing eye-watering amounts in increasingly industrial, brazen and sophisticated ways.

metas.name: Inside the Arrest
metas.description:
Inside the Arrest captures the moment of arrest, conducted more than two thousand times a day by British police, in order to investigate or prevent a crime. The arrest is the start point for every story, a high-stakes moment that can be met with anything from violence to defiance, confession to incredulity.

Each episode features two cases using police bodycam footage to analyse some notorious and high-profile arrests from recent years.

metas.name: The Crash Detectives
metas.description: Series going inside the cordon with Gwent Police's dedicated forensic collision investigators, as they deal with serious incidents on the roads.

metas.name: Highland Cops
metas.description: Welcome to Britain's biggest beat. Covering 12,000 square miles of loch, glens, islands and mountains, cutting-edge crime fighting meets traditional ways of life.

metas.name: Police: Night Shift 999
metas.description: Following the night shift of Gloucestershire Constabulary, revealing the relentless and uphill fight against night-time crime. As darkness falls across the county, officers face incidents with more drink, drugs and violence than during the day.

metas.name: Night Coppers
metas.description: Ten thousand revellers pack Brighton’s clubs and pubs every weekend, and as the sun goes down and the lights come up, the number of assaults, sexual violence, anti-social behaviour, drug-related incidents and hate crime goes through the roof – and for the Night Coppers of Brighton, policing this city after dark is one hell of a ride.

metas.name: Manhunt
metas.description: Cameras follow a specialist police unit dealing with urgent manhunts.

metas.name: Rookie Cops
metas.description: A career change with a difference - becoming a new recruit to the police in Wales. Coming from all walks of life, how do they adapt to being thrown into the front line of the law?

metas.name: Football Cops
metas.description: Behind the scenes with the cops working to stop trouble at matches, from England games to the Premier League and below.

metas.name: Police Raid: Minute by Minute
metas.description: Officers mount a major operation to tackle drug dealing in south Wales.

metas.name: Police Interceptors: Pursuit and Capture
metas.description: Full-throttle documentary series featuring the UK's police in breath-taking chases.
